title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) here, or tap More info on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig in.

items.headline_md: Update: **Brazil**: Lula wins a fourth term in the runoff, and Flávio Bolsonaro will try to annul the result
items.summary_md: Lula took 51.76% to Flávio Bolsonaro's 48.24%, a margin of more than 4 million votes; Bolsonaro says he will petition to annul the result.

items.headline_md: Update: **Serbia**: Vučić concedes as the student list wins, ending his SNS party's 14 years in power
items.summary_md: Ipsos/CeSID projections give "Student List – Students Win" 52% against 39.3% for the SNS.

items.headline_md: Update: **Bulgaria**: President Iliana Iotova leads the first round with about 35.3%, so a runoff is needed
items.summary_md: No candidate cleared the threshold to win outright.

items.headline_md: **Trump** urges Israelis to re-elect Netanyahu and "finish the job" in Iran
items.summary_md: Reported in Anadolu's Monday morning briefing.

items.headline_md: **Kenya**: a bus and a truck crash on the Nairobi–Mombasa highway, killing at least 22
items.summary_md: At least 22 people died.

items.headline_md: Update: **Nigeria Ebola**: 53 contacts traced so far
items.summary_md: This follows the case reported last week.

items.headline_md: **Orbán for UN chief?** WSJ says Trump officials have floated Viktor Orbán for UN secretary-general
items.summary_md: Euronews, citing the Wall Street Journal, also says Zelensky's Brussels talks are in doubt after the US changed its plans.

items.headline_md: **EQT** to buy **Range Resources** in an all-stock deal of about $13 billion
items.summary_md: Dow Jones reports the deal is about $13B. Before the open, Range was up 15% and EQT down 4% (CNBC). The deal is expected to close in Q1 2027.

items.headline_md: Update: **Meta** launches a $35 billion stock offering to fund its AI build-out
items.summary_md: The offering mixes common and convertible preferred shares. CNBC says Meta also plans to raise $60B through an at-the-market program, and the stock was up 1% before the open.

items.headline_md: **Verizon** raises its 2026 forecasts and signs a $2 billion-plus AI fiber deal with AWS
items.summary_md: It added 406K postpaid phones in Q3. It now expects 1.1–1.2M adds for the year and adjusted EPS of $5.04–5.06. Revenue of $34.3B missed the $34.74B estimate.

items.headline_md: **Santander** falls more than 5% after Lula's win, and **Galp** drops more than 8% as merger talks with Moeve collapse
items.summary_md: These were European moves on Monday morning.

items.headline_md: **Surgery Partners** jumps almost 25% on an FT report that Bon Secours Mercy Health is nearing a $6 billion takeover
items.summary_md: The take-private would value the company at $20 a share and could be announced Monday.

items.headline_md: **AT&T Mexico** sold to a Televisa-led consortium for about $2 billion
items.summary_md: AT&T is exiting its Mexican wireless business.

sections.title: Games & mobile
sections.body_md: No new hyper-casual or hybrid-casual chart news since Friday's brief.

items.headline_md: Update: **Arkane Lyon** gets until Dec 13, and Microsoft is now seeking a partner to finish **Marvel's Blade**
items.summary_md: The consultation on closing the studio moved from Nov 13 to Dec 13. Microsoft calls it "a defined extension," and 217 jobs are at stake.

items.headline_md: **Shenmue III Enhanced** slips to early 2027 on PS5, Xbox, Switch 2 and PC
items.summary_md: An ININ Games newsletter confirms the delay. No exact date has been given.

items.headline_md: **Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis** gets a 30th-anniversary teaser ahead of its Feb 12, 2027 launch
items.summary_md: Lara's first adventure is being reimagined for PS5, Xbox, PC and Switch 2.

items.headline_md: Update: **#SaveMassEffect** petition passes 188,000 signatures after BioWare's closure
items.summary_md: It asks EA to keep developing **Mass Effect** or license it to another studio. Shepard actors Jennifer Hale and Mark Meer have also mourned BioWare.

items.headline_md: **Minecraft** for Switch 2 arrives Oct 27 and is free for owners of the digital version
items.summary_md: It's one of this week's Switch 2 releases.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: **Wii U lifter watch:** still no public repo for the r/decomps Wii U-to-x86 lifter. GitHub and web searches only turned up the per-game Wii U recomps. **Watch list:** **KytyPS5** had routine nightlies only. **AnyPS5** has no release since v0.1.3. The **Astro Bot** fork has no commits since Oct 12. **WWHD Recomp** only pushed a devel build, and **flossbud's WWHDRecomp** has been quiet since Oct 17. **LASRecomp** has had only test builds since Beta 5.2 and is not stable yet. **Caution:** a new "Switch2Emu" GitHub repo says itself that no games run, so treat Switch 2/PS5 emulator download claims as scams. Reddit (r/decomps, r/emulation) blocked my computer this morning (HTTP 429).

items.headline_md: **Sky Recomp (Skyward Sword HD)** v2.0: Switch-to-PC recomp fixes the random freezes and crashes at 60/120 fps
items.summary_md: v2.0.0 came out Sat 9:58 PM AZ, with v2.0.1 and v2.0.2 on Sunday adding language, setup and cutscene fixes. It needs your own Skyward Sword HD v1.0.0 data.

items.headline_md: **Kirikae** v0.1.2: the Switch-to-Windows static recompiler adds Linux support and fixes GPU memory corruption
items.summary_md: Released Sat 4:09 PM AZ, it adds Linux linking, a Vulkan window and gamepads on Linux, and build-time jump-table discovery. It's still an early preview tested on only a handful of games.

items.headline_md: **SMM2 Recomp (Super Mario Maker 2)** v0.5.5 adds the OpenCourse World online backend on PC
items.summary_md: v0.5.4 (Sat 11:07 PM AZ) added mod support and a GameBanana browser. v0.5.5 (Sun 2:36 AM AZ) added online courses and fixed a 100 Mario communication error.

items.headline_md: **Lost Odyssey Recomp** v1.1.0: the Xbox 360-to-PC port adds button prompts and more menu languages
items.summary_md: Released Sun 6:12 PM AZ, it adds game-icon prompts for Switch, Deck and keyboard, plus Spanish, French, German and Italian settings menus.

items.headline_md: **Blast Corps Recompiled** hits 1.0.0, a native N64-to-PC port for Windows, Linux and Mac
items.summary_md: Catching up from Friday 5:33 AM AZ, this is the first full release. You need your own ROM.

sections.title: Movies
sections.body_md: The weekend's actual total was $92.9M (The Numbers).

items.headline_md: Update: **Clayface** opens #1 with $24.0M (actual)
items.summary_md: It earned an A- CinemaScore and 75% on Rotten Tomatoes, plus $19M overseas, for $43M worldwide on a $44M budget.

items.headline_md: Update: **You Can See Everything** rises 25% to $19.5M in its second weekend, for $45.1M total
items.summary_md: A24's Elizabeth Holmes documentary has 98% on Rotten Tomatoes and best-picture buzz. It cost $7M.

items.headline_md: Update: **Wildwood** opens third with $11.0M
items.summary_md: Laika's film has 100% on Rotten Tomatoes and an A CinemaScore, but its reported $100M budget sets a high bar.

items.headline_md: **Street Fighter** falls 72% to $8.6M, while **Wicker** opens with $5.75M
items.summary_md: Street Fighter now has $46.9M domestic, and Wicker holds 94% on Rotten Tomatoes.

items.headline_md: **Klara and the Sun** flops with about $725K from 880 theaters
items.summary_md: Taika Waititi's Ishiguro adaptation opened outside the top 10.

items.headline_md: **This weekend:** Halloween falls on Saturday, so the studios are mostly sitting out
items.summary_md: Wide releases are Liam Neeson's **The Mongoose**, **The Only Living Pickpocket in New York**, **Christmas at the Kringles** and Disney's **Everest: The Other Side**.

items.headline_md: **Nov 6:** The Cat in the Hat, Godzilla Minus Zero and Wild Horse Nine
items.summary_md: These are the next big wide releases.

items.headline_md: **SpaceX** closes $40 billion in debt to buy AI GPUs, and Musk predicts a neocloud shakeout
items.summary_md: The mostly callable debt funds GPUs arriving in the first half of 2027. Musk says 200+ neoclouds face "guppy-level death." SpaceX's AI unit made $7.56B in Q3 revenue.

items.headline_md: **SoftBank** plans $50 billion of AI and data-center investment in Malaysia, PM Anwar says
items.summary_md: The sites are in Kuching, Sarawak and peninsular Malaysia. SoftBank didn't comment.

items.headline_md: **SWI Compute** launches Nvidia-based AI factories in Europe
items.summary_md: Its plan totals 3.6 GW, including a 30 MW Cambridge site with about 7,000 Rubin GPUs and about $1B in orders.

items.headline_md: **AI chatbots and drugs:** a study finds 1 in 3 young US adults use AI chatbots for drug information
items.summary_md: Euronews also has a new Geoffrey Hinton interview.

items.headline_md: **iPhone Duo** teardown: iFixit gives it 5/10, the best score yet for a foldable, and points to a hinge stress spot behind the screen cracks
items.summary_md: Batteries release with an electric charge, but the inner display and hinge are hard to repair. The Galaxy Z Fold8 and Pixel 11 Pro Fold both scored 4/10.

items.headline_md: **Google Play**: the API 36 target deadline for existing apps hits Nov 1
items.summary_md: After that, apps that don't target API 36 are hidden from new users, though existing installs keep working.

items.headline_md: **Apple** stores roll out a Presto-based scanner that checks iPhones inside sealed boxes to fight return fraud
items.summary_md: It runs diagnostics without opening the box, per Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.

items.headline_md: **Apple** blocks compromised eMudhra TLS certificates, with a macOS command-line fix coming
items.summary_md: Safari, Mail and system frameworks have blocked them since Oct 19.

items.headline_md: **Gabon** lifts its eight-month social media ban
items.summary_md: The ban had lasted eight months.

sections.title: Markets
sections.body_md: This week: the Fed decides Wednesday (CNBC: fed funds futures show 90% odds of a hold at 3.75–4%), PCE comes Oct 29, and about a third of the S&P 500 reports, including Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon (Reuters).

items.headline_md: **US futures** up: Dow +209 (0.4%) and S&P 500 +0.1% as of 4:36 AM AZ
items.summary_md: Reuters had Dow e-minis +0.49% at 2:19 AM AZ.

items.headline_md: **Oil** falls: Brent −1.7% to $114.77 and WTI −2% to $100.97 (4:36 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: Brent hit a six-month high last week.

items.headline_md: **Gold** back above $4,000: spot +0.5% to $4,014.49 an ounce (CNBC, early Monday; exact quote time not given)
items.summary_md: Friday's $3,975 was its lowest since July 20.

items.headline_md: **Crypto**: Bitcoin $80,256 (−0.25% in 24h) and Ether $2,328.80 (−0.27%) at 5:09 AM AZ
items.summary_md: Little change overnight.

items.headline_md: **Premarket movers** (4:48 AM AZ): Tesla +2% on a Barclays upgrade, Moderna −8%, CoreWeave −5% and Fair Isaac −10%
items.summary_md: Ross Stores rose 6.5% on a UBS upgrade, and Nebius fell 3.5%.

items.headline_md: **Phoenix**: sunny, high near 85, low around 59, 0% rain all day
items.summary_md: No alerts.

items.headline_md: **Show Low**: sunny, high near 65, low around 37, 0–1% rain
items.summary_md: It was 32° early this morning. No alerts.

items.headline_md: **Snowflake**: patchy fog before 9 AM, then sunny, high near 67, low around 37, 0% rain
items.summary_md: No alerts.

items.headline_md: **AppLovin vs. Unity**: Digiday explains the "data leakage" court fight that could reshape mobile ad monetization
items.summary_md: It covers how much data a rival SDK can take from an in-app ad auction, which matters for every app running mediation.
